title: The all-Houston boat playlist
caption:
The most Houston playlist ever played on a boat 🤘🎶 What did we miss? Wrong answers get roasted.

#houstonmusic #htx #htown #clearlake

slides.headline: The all-Houston boat playlist
slides.body: Eight songs, one city. Tell us what we missed.

slides.headline: Texas Hold 'Em. Beyonce.
slides.body: Houston's own. The whole boat knows the words. Non negotiable.

slides.headline: Savage. Megan Thee Stallion.
slides.body: Hot girl summer runs through Houston. Even in November.

slides.headline: Sicko Mode. Travis Scott.
slides.body: The beat switch hits different on open water.

slides.headline: Texas Sun. Khruangbin and Leon Bridges.
slides.body: Khruangbin is from Houston. Play this one at golden hour.

slides.headline: Int'l Players Anthem. UGK.
slides.body: Bun B and Pimp C. Required listening in this city.

slides.headline: Sittin' Sidewayz. Paul Wall.
slides.body: Slowed down, of course. It's a Houston boat.

slides.headline: Say My Name. Destiny's Child.
slides.body: The group chat will turn this into a duet. Let it happen.

slides.headline: La Grange. ZZ Top.
slides.body: For the uncle who came along. He'll be the first one up.

slides.headline: What did we miss?
slides.body: Drop your Houston song in the comments. Wrong answers get roasted. @houstonpedalbarge
